description: This file defines the class JitReports, which extends Jit and provides functionality for processing and generating XML data reports, particularly for charts in the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM environment. It includes methods for calculating totals, processing report data, and rendering chart visualizations.

classes.name: JitReports
classes.description: A class extending Jit to handle report data processing and visualization for SugarCRM/SuiteCRM charts.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the class, calling the parent constructor.

methods.name: calculateReportGroupTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total of 'numerical_value' fields within a dataset.

methods.name: isCurrencyReportGroupTotal
methods.description: Checks whether all 'numerical_is_currency' fields in the dataset are empty, indicating if report totals are in currency.

methods.name: processReportData
methods.description: Recursively processes report data into a specific format for display, handling nested groupings.

methods.name: processReportGroup
methods.description: Determines the super set of grouping keys from a dataset for report processing.

methods.name: xmlDataReportSingleValue
methods.description: Generates XML data for charts when there is a single value per dataset.

methods.name: xmlDataReportChart
methods.description: Generates XML data suitable for rendering charts, including handling currency formatting.

methods.name: processXmlData
methods.description: Main method to process and generate the complete XML data for a report.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Prepares and returns HTML/Smarty code to display the chart, wrapping the chart in a div.
